name: Esade Business School (Universitat Ramon Llull)

program.notes: Fees page FAQ: 12 months, four residential modules and a global immersion.

tuition_total.notes: 'Total compulsory MBA tuition fees and expenses'; covers tuition, materials, IT, library. Paid as 8,000 reservation + 8,000 commitment + 50% by Sept 2027 + remainder by March 2028.

mandatory_fees_total.notes: MBA Student Association fee 100 EUR; application fee 150 EUR not included.

living_budget_total.notes: No official living budget on the fees page.

scholarship.notes: Esade awards (women-focused awards, Forte fellowships min. USD 10,000), ISA backed by the European Investment Fund, external scholarships (Princess of Girona up to 75% of tuition for Spanish nationals/residents, Colfuturo up to 15%). No average award or share of class published.

base_salary.notes: Class of 2025 employment report is gated behind a request form; no base salary on the open pages. The careers page quotes FT 2026 data (USD 206,389 PPP average weighted salary 3 years after graduation; 155% increase) - FT alumni figure, not a starting salary.

internship_monthly.notes: 'average monthly salary for students on internship'; cohort not stated. 67% of interns stay in Europe.

employment.top_employers_notes: Alphabetical list of companies that recruited Esade candidates in the last 3 years (subset of ~50 listed); no hire counts.
employment.notes: '55% securing roles internationally' (Class of 2025) used as country_change_pct.

profile.notes: Women 42% / men 54% from the school's infogram (https://e.infogram.com/cc9c1955-2912-483c-855e-a241b427e332); 95% international and 40+ nationalities from https://e.infogram.com/4eb9a6f0-707a-4f8f-80eb-512a97d33a43. Prior sector: corporate 24%, financial services 17%, consulting 11%.

rankings_cited.notes: Excerpt of the FT 2026 table on ClearAdmit (prior year 8).

notes: Report gated; no salary or industry/geography breakdown readable without submitting the form.
